description: Get a single task by id with full detail — status, assignees, custom fields, dates, and optionally subtasks and the markdown description. Use to inspect one known task.

custom_task_ids.description: Set true to treat `task_id` as a custom task ID instead of a native ClickUp ID. Requires `team_id`.

include_markdown_description.description: If true, include the description rendered as markdown.

include_subtasks.description: If true, include the task's subtasks in the response.

task_id.description: ID of the task to fetch.

team_id.description: Team/Workspace ID. Falls back to CLICKUP_TEAM_ID when omitted.

name: get_task
